stories.headline: Anthropic IPO: upsized offering priced above its range, opened up 30%, market cap briefly $2 trillion
stories.quote: Anthropic’s sensational IPO — the upsized offering priced above its range and popped 30% at the opening, briefly giving the company a market cap of $2 trillion — is unusual in so many ways that it’s hard to know where to start.

facts.text: The offering was upsized and priced above its range.

briefly giving the company a market cap of $2 trillion

facts.text: Described as the biggest IPO of all time, including a private placement, surpassing SpaceX.

stories.headline: SpaceX IPO cited as the previous largest, now surpassed by Anthropic's
stories.quote: It’s the biggest initial public offering of all time by a fair margin (including a private placement), easily surpassing SpaceX, but that fact barely rates next to some of its other novel features...
